text: Exit by selling reputation tokens is more problematic for reputation than for other cryptocurrency tokens, because reputation is less fungible: a token's value is tied to the specific post in which the reputation was created and is subject to separate review.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3949098

isBasedOn.name: Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance

abstract: This is more problematic for reputation than for most other cryptocurrency tokens, since reputation is less fungible because a token's value is tied to the post in which the reputation was created and subject to separate review. But in principle it could be algorithmically valued.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: a member wants to exit by selling reputation tokens at fair market value
